blind.description: A gothic death-themed idol consisting of a tiered, pale stone architectural pedestal framing an upright glowing white hourglass flanked by dark pillars with brass/gold accents, surmounted by a large stylized black raven perched on top looking forward. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, melted, or detached components. Underside rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: The dark, feathery body, folded wings, and beak of a raven resting over the wider shoulders and rectangular foundation of a pale stone plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.8 to 4 feet tall), and about one-third as wide as the figure is tall.
